review_status: Complete source and independent layout review; original electrical continuity unverified

review_notes.note: Native CL explicitly prints C514F2, A-C4G5. The A1 index does not match that literal; the printed leading C is preserved.

CL prints C514F2, retained as printed. EH is at printed grid 4G. AG, BN, EH, EJ, GJ/GK/GL/GM and GN printed stars retained. Physical output-border wedges on the latch B10 rows remain symbols, not card letters. Numeric 6D12/6D11 qualifiers and inline6 marks on the BH/DM outputs were read directly, corroborated by an independent high agent source view; no separate unapproved circle glyph is substituted.

All native parity/write-control return rails, the latch true output into DC, positive P0 into DC/DL, both delayed clock polarities, scan control and FM feedback were traced from the source. Only printed diamonds join wires. External output reference pairs and all26 connector-table rows retained.

Some lettering and local wire strokes are washed or interrupted. Readable remaining printing is retained; normalized wire-glyph continuity does not certify source electrical continuity. Footer title, LOG153A, part2585445, GP and one revision retained.

Native-size inspection and independent high-agent source review confirm DM E05, GK F05, GM F13 and GL B05. The routing corner is separated from these pin glyphs; printed E/F letters are preserved rather than replaced with D.

AG4 output literally prints - ST BUS PARITY 32-19, with a clear 1 in the final range. The parity input and EH/EJ legends print 32-39. These separate native literals are retained; no range is inferred from the circuit function.
EB B13 upper feedback endpoint and FE lower true-output bend are plain elbows, independently checked in native20/native31; only genuine diamonds retained.

Native page lettering, ports, printed wedges, diamonds, routes and footer reviewed independently. User-approved printer grid verified from printed grid labels, multiple native borders and local source character pitch. Independent root review pending.

All38 native portions, labels/wedges/stars/printed numeric prefixes and inline6 controls examined. C514F2 literal and source A1 mismatch, EH4G, DM E05/GK F05/GM F13/GL B05 preserved. All upper latch folded controls/clock/feedback rails and lower parity/write/scan/delay returns traced; P0 positive branches DC/DL, FM write-return DN and gate inputs, AG/BN upward external output returns, paired destinations FC/GN and four GT writes compared. All26 connector rows, margin and footer2585445GP/08-14-69/153A/713380/fulltitle compared. Extra diamonds removed; AG4 source range32-19 corrected and independently rechecked. Full independent source and current complete preview comparison recorded in mid/takeover/low-crossreview/Independent cross reviews.json. Removed invented EB.B13 endpoint (137,14) and FE lower elbow (178,37) diamonds. Corrected AG4 right output literal to32-19 matching native closecrop; repeated32-39 elsewhere retained. Current full production preview and changed detail crops agree.
